When Codex has more to say

Complex answers unfold in layers—not in tiny text.

The watch provides enough information to understand the outcome and choose the next action. Explanation, evidence, and full technical output appear only when the user asks for them.

Watch = understand + decide
iPhone / Mac = inspect + act
